description: This file implements a Mount Provider API in C, including functions for mounting and unmounting, handling attributes like mount point, path, key, and partition, and managing key data. It contains API entry points, attribute handlers, and test stubs.

methods.name: rdkssaMountMountpoint
methods.description: Handles setting the mount point attribute, copying the value into the mount parameters structure.

methods.name: rdkssaMountPath
methods.description: Handles setting the path attribute, copying the value into the mount parameters structure.

methods.name: rdkssaMountKey
methods.description: Handles setting the key attribute, reading key data from a file or stdin into the mount parameters structure.

methods.name: rdkssaMountPartition
methods.description: Placeholder for handling partition attribute, not implemented.

methods.name: mountWriteKeyCallback
methods.description: Callback function to write key data to a file descriptor, used during mounting.

methods.name: rdkssaMount
methods.description: Main API function to perform mounting, processes attributes, and invokes external mount command.

methods.name: rdkssaUnmount
methods.description: Stub for unmount operation, not implemented.
